title: codec
description: A plugin-shipped body codec: how a content type is decoded and encoded, and what a decoded body is -- the declared type (json, form, multipart), or a fixed type (text yields string). A plugin's settings map content types to codecs explicitly.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/codec.schema.json.

description.description: What this codec reads and writes, in one or two sentences.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

yields.description: declared: the shape the trigger or operation names; otherwise the fixed type every decoded body has.
